status: MIXED USER-REPORTED MEASUREMENTS AND SELECTED ASSUMPTIONS — NOT MEASURED THERMAL PROPERTIES
purpose: Forward sensitivity / measurement planning; not a thermal-property fit, ablation model, or engine qualification.
range_interpretation: Selected endpoint sensitivity envelope, not a statistical confidence interval or proven physical bound. Unlisted model errors can exceed it.

width_mm.basis: User confirmed nominal brick size 2 × 3.5 × 0.5 inches in this conversation; corroborated by December 12 design review slide 11. Ranges analyst-selected, not measured manufacturing tolerances.

height_mm.basis: Same user-confirmed nominal dimensions; no individual caliper measurements or tolerances available.

thickness_mm.basis: Same user-confirmed nominal thickness; actual local thickness variation and sensor depth are not measured.

cp_J_kgK.basis: Analyst-selected constant-property scenario; not a measured or literature-validated value for this batch.

k_W_mK.basis: Nominal reused only as an assumption from semiinfiniteablative.tex lines 99–102; that earlier calculation cites no material-property measurement. Factor-two range analyst-selected.

dimple_diameter_mm.basis: Analyst-selected circular footprint. Not dimensioned from photos; not a measured flame footprint.

heated_diameter_mm.basis: Separate analyst-selected uniformly heated circular footprint. Not inferred from the dimple diameter and varied independently.

depression_shape_factor.basis: V=f*projected_area*depth: paraboloid nominal; cone-to-cylinder scenario range. Not fitted to a surface scan.

graphite_flux_multiplier.basis: Report sensitivity to ±20% graphite heat capacity; not complete flux uncertainty and not a brick absorptivity factor.

mass_g.basis: Analyst-selected baseline pre-test mass; no baseline mass measurement is available.

duration_s.basis: Reported nominal exposure; ±1 s is an analyst timing scenario, not measured timing error.

depth_mm.basis: Analyst-selected baseline example, NOT an image measurement. Retained as a hypothesis, not adjusted to enforce the earlier qualitative photo ordering.

mass_g.basis: User confirmed pre-test mass for the hot 10 s / approximately 2.25× reference-flux test. Instrument uncertainty and conditioning/cleaning state were not supplied.
mass_g.sensitivity_treatment: Held fixed at reported value; unknown measurement uncertainty is excluded, not zero.

post_test_mass_g.basis: User confirmed post-test mass for the same hot specimen. Instrument uncertainty and conditioning/cleaning state were not supplied.
post_test_mass_g.sensitivity_treatment: Held fixed at reported value; unknown measurement uncertainty is excluded, not zero.

duration_s.basis: Reported nominal exposure; ±1 s is an analyst timing scenario, not measured timing error.

depth_mm.basis: User confirmed approximately 1/8 inch dimple depth for this hot specimen. Conversion is exactly 3.175 mm, not measurement precision. Reference-plane method and measurement uncertainty were not supplied.
depth_mm.sensitivity_treatment: Held fixed at reported value; unknown measurement uncertainty is excluded, not zero.

geometry: Uniform rectangular specimen; circular depression V=f*πD²d/4 with paraboloid f=1/2 nominal and cone-to-cylinder f=1/3..1 scenarios. Char-rim swelling, cracks, shedding, porosity changes and density changes are excluded.
thermal_model: Homogeneous constant-property original virgin slab, using alpha=k/(rho*cp). Diffusion length sqrt(alpha*t) is a convention, not a sharp front or ablation depth. L²/alpha is a characteristic scale, not an onset prediction.

sources.role: Design corroboration of nominal dimensions; user separately confirmed 2 × 3.5 × 0.5 inches. Not individual specimen metrology.
